Themes

Every theme on a dashboard.

All 20 themes from the built-in store, each applied to an Unraid 7 dashboard. Install any of them from Settings → Unraid Themer → Theme store. The dashboard here is a mock-up with made-up data, so details differ from a real server, but every theme file is applied unchanged. Click a picture for full size, or open the live preview to switch themes and icon sets yourself.
